announcements.headline: AGM – Revised Form of Proxy
announcements.insight: GoldStone Resources Ltd issued a revised proxy for the November AGM, following earlier notices regarding interest conversion and loan terms. Shareholders should review the updated form to ensure their votes are recorded correctly.

announcements.headline: Circular, AGM Notice & Interest Conversion
announcements.insight: GoldStone Resources Ltd seeks shareholder approval to convert debt into equity, following earlier gold loan standstill and interest waiver extensions.

announcements.headline: Homase Pit Definition & JORC Exploration Plan
announcements.insight: GoldStone Resources Ltd outlines a JORC exploration plan for the Homase Pit. This follows recent gold loan standstill and interest waiver extensions, indicating ongoing financial restructuring efforts.

announcements.headline: Gold Loan Interest Waiver Extension
announcements.insight: GoldStone Resources Ltd extends its gold loan standstill, following June’s extension. This variation to subscription suggests ongoing restructuring efforts.
